name: Sheetal Universal Ltd.
summary: Sheetal Universal Ltd. operates within the agriculture industry, specializing in the processing, packaging, and supply of various agricultural commodities. The company's primary products include edible oils, peanuts, sesame seeds, pulses, spices such as fenugreek, cumin, turmeric, dill seeds, kalunji, and fennel seeds, as well as grains like sorghum, rice, and chickpeas. They also offer other products such as raisins, desiccated coconut, and dehydrated onion and garlic. Sheetal Universal caters to manufacturers of food products including peanut butter, biscuits, cakes, and chocolate. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant export activities to countries including the Russian Federation, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, UAE, Iran, Algeria, Israel, Turkey, and Egypt. It handles both certified organic and conventional product requirements for its clients. The company also plans to establish facilities for manufacturing defatted protein powder and cold press oil.
